about: PAE-02 SCION 49: what the dog did, measured per frame from the rendered dog layers (build/cache/measure.json). facing: +1 the drawn body faces the door (left), -1 its back is turned. x_world_measured is the body-layer centroid in metres along the porch with the camera undone (the camera pushes in from 21 s); its offset from the score x differs by cut (standing pointer vs lying Juno). States are assigned from measured onsets (see build/trace.py).
